faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What products do you use? Are they safe?
faq.a1: I use only 100% genuine, premium international brands like MAC, Huda Beauty, Kryolan, NARS, and Forever52. All products are thoroughly sanitized and completely safe for all skin types.
faq.q2: Can you do a specific makeup style I found on Instagram?
faq.a2: Absolutely! Show me your reference photos during our consultation, and we can recreate the exact style, or customize it to perfectly suit your features and outfit.
faq.q3: What exactly does the price cover?
faq.a3: The service price covers the complete Makeover, Hairstyle, and Saree Draping, plus any false lashes and standard hair extensions. Only travel is extra (approx. ₹500 based on exact distance).
faq.q4: Do you travel to the wedding venue?
faq.a4: Yes, I travel all across Bangalore directly to your home or venue so you can get ready comfortably. Early morning bookings are fully supported!
faq.a5: Yes! I offer trial demos at my home studio (ladies only) so you can feel 100% confident in your look before the big day.
faq.q6: What if my event starts very early (e.g., 5 AM)?
faq.a6: I am very comfortable with early morning 'Muhurtham' timings. I will arrive at your venue as early as needed to ensure you are ready perfectly on time.
